verses.text: And it came to pass, when all the kings of the Amorite who [were] beyond the Jordan westward, and all the kings of the Canaanite who [were] along the sea, heard that YHWH had dried up the waters of the Jordan from before the face of the sons of Israel until they passed over, that their heart melted, and there was no longer a spirit in them, because of the face of the sons of Israel.
